title: Backrooms Chess
summary: Horror 'Backrooms' chess: the player is a lone black king lost on a huge yellow Backrooms-themed board; every turn new white pieces spawn and hunt the king, and the goal is to find and capture the hidden 'anomalous' white king.
rules: Player controls only a lone Black king.
White starts with a king (the 'anomalous white king', hidden somewhere far away) plus a few pieces (e.g. a bishop, a knight, a pawn).
Every turn White spawns new pieces at locations on the map (game 2: one new bishop, one new knight and one new pawn each turn).
White pieces use normal movement and can check/capture the king; the player may capture them.

Transcript describes walls/tiles blocking lines (corners safer vs bishops), but frames show an open very large board with no visible walls — FRAME EVIDENCE WINS: build an open giant board; walls are at most sparse/optional.
win_condition: Capture the anomalous white king. Lose if your king is captured.
